verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships a server mode (`llama serve`, a 'Server' section) with a built-in web UI, plus Docker deployment, so models are served over HTTP. Nothing in the pack shows binding to a network interface or reaching the server from other devices on a LAN, so that part is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of host/port binding for LAN access, any API or endpoint details, and hands-on reports of accessing the server from other devices.
